note: Hot reads taken from the domain modules. expected=index means the plan must use an index; any records the plan without failing.

queries.name: appointment_start_for_app
queries.why: Calendar: the running session for one app (idx2_appts on app,timestamp)
queries.sql: select uuid from appointments where app='home' and (type='start' or type='record') and stop_seen is null and timestamp <= 1793500000000 order by timestamp desc limit 1

queries.name: appointment_since
queries.why: Calendar: what is next (idx7_appts on timestamp,seen)
queries.sql: select app,uuid,timestamp from appointments where timestamp >= 1793500000000 and seen is null order by timestamp limit 10

queries.name: appointment_exact
queries.why: People: one app at one instant (idx12_appts on type,app)
queries.sql: select * from appointments where app='home' and timestamp=1793500000000 and type='email'

queries.name: appointment_duty
queries.why: Calendar duties: the leading column is a long text column, so a scan is the planner's answer today
queries.sql: select * from appointments where duties is not null and next_duty >= 1793500000000 and next_duty is not null limit 10
